ds_value: At first exposure of component (Timing Code 4); next planned HGP or MI outage at or before rotor reaches 378,000 equivalent cold rotor turning time hours.
our_value: Next planned outage for the unit Hot Gas Path (HGP) or Major Inspection (MI) at or before the rotor reaches a total of 378,000 equivalent cold rotor turning time.

ds_value: Perform fluorescent penetrant inspection (FPI) for all BWG entry slots on the CAS and DP during the next planned HGP or MI outage at or before the rotor reaches 378,000 equivalent cold rotor turning time (ECRT) hours
For FPI clear cases - evaluate all balance entry slot corner conditions with replication process
If any balance weight entry slot corner condition presents with a <0.060" fillet size - perform entry slot blending, FPI, and peening operations
If any portion of a specific balance weight groove corner meets the <0.060" fillet criteria, perform modification machining on the entire BWG entry slot corner
Fillet >0.060" and uniformly this size over full length of the BWG entry slot corner - leave in as-found condition
For cases with observable FPI indication/indications - contact GE engineering through an ER case for technical disposition
In service center, MPI inspection may be substituted for FPI inspection based on service center capability
our_value: Perform fluorescent penetrant inspection (FPI) for all BWG entry slots on the CAS and DP during the next planned HGP or MI.
Evaluate all balance entry slot corner conditions with replication process if FPI is clear.
Perform entry slot blending, FPI, and peening operations if any balance weight entry slot corner condition presents with a <0.060" fillet size.
Contact GE engineering through an ER case for technical disposition if observable FPI indications are found.
Leave in as-found condition if fillet is > 0.060" and uniform over full length.

ds_value.context: Compressor Aft Shaft (CAS) - balance weight groove entry slots requiring FPI inspection and potential blending
Distance Piece (DP) - balance weight groove entry slots requiring FPI inspection and potential blending
BWG Entry Slot Portable Machining Tool - special tooling required for blending operation
Flapper peening kit - required for peening modified geometry post machining
